column1: # Golden vectors for SRS 7.2 latch.source_hash / latch.item_key.
# THIS FILE IS A CROSS-CLIENT CONFORMANCE SUITE. The Android, Windows and Chrome
# clients are written independently, and AC-07 requires all three to derive the same
# digest from the same message. Prose will not hold three codebases byte-identical;
# this table will. A client that cannot reproduce every digest below fails AC-07.
# Columns: name <TAB> input <TAB> expected sha-256 of the normalised input
# The input column is escaped and the file is pure ASCII by design, so that an editor
# normalising Unicode on save cannot silently turn one case into another.
# Blank lines and lines beginning # are ignored.
# Each case is a way the same message reaches two platforms differently. Every case
# from crlf_vs_lf to mixed_case must produce the SAME digest as plain; nfc_cafe and
# nfd_cafe must match each other; whitespace_only must match empty.
